implementation_status: implemented; package regressions and independent local SMTP/callback acceptance verified
security_notes: Verified external callbacks are bound to a configured client and contain delivery identifiers and references, not email bodies or credentials.
no_op_semantics: Identical callback replays do not repeat completed inbox processing; external listener effects still require idempotency.
notes: Laravel integration events are separate from the service-owned mail domain events.
no_events_reason: The consumer bridge owns no local mail-delivery domain lifecycle. It adapts versioned remote delivery callbacks to Laravel listeners.

integration_events.publication: Laravel event dispatch from a durably queued, lease-fenced receipt processor.
